t: Configure persistent memory for lug-reviewer and code-simplifier subagents
description: The lug-reviewer and code-simplifier agents in .claude/agents/ have no memory configuration. Without 'memory: project' they start blind every invocation — no recall of past lug quality decisions, no pattern learning across reviews. Given lug quality is a core concern (anti-pattern about placeholders, Ozi enforcement), giving lug-reviewer persistent memory of past decisions compounds significantly over time.
perceive: Read .claude/agents/lug-reviewer.md and code-simplifier.md for current configuration. Check CC docs for agent memory configuration format. Check if agent memory dirs exist at ~/.claude/agents/memory/.
execute: Add memory configuration to both agent definition files. For lug-reviewer: enable project-scoped memory so it remembers past lug quality decisions, common violations, and patterns across sessions. For code-simplifier: enable project-scoped memory for code style patterns observed.
verify: Both agent files have memory config. Spawning lug-reviewer agent shows it can access memory. No regressions in agent behavior.
acceptance_criteria: lug-reviewer.md has memory configuration enabling project-scoped persistence
code-simplifier.md has memory configuration enabling project-scoped persistence
Agent memory dirs created if needed
Both agents still function correctly after config change
